assertions.text: States Question 1 includes both the surviving reviewer (Codex) and the "No further round for now" option (2 options total), even though the triggered-cycle count is below min_rounds
Identifies this as the documented one-survivor exception to the general below-floor omission rule, not a contradiction between the two rules

States that selecting "No further round for now" in this case does NOT simply stop with nothing posted — it reports the round-floor requirement and stops for the user to confirm triggering the one remaining reviewer or fix the reviewer configuration
Does not describe the outcome as the general authoritative silent stop ("ignore Question 2, stop, nothing gets posted") for this specific below-floor one-survivor case
